`428209 (2006 VC)` exceeds the radiation momentum ceiling (eps = 1.28) with a reliable orbit solution and is not in the channel's explained set.

A2 = 6.4e-13 au/day^2, S/N 3.8, arc 7139.0 d, diameter 341 m (from H).

Next step is `loom-litcheck --name "428209 (2006 VC)"`: the dark-comet population is incomplete and most exceedances resolve to it.

active.body:
The `asassn` adapter reached its service but has no usable path to a light curve.

Reason recorded by the probe: no cone request was accepted (every variant and format in the matrix above), and the vendor client cannot be imported here -- so there is no path to a light curve, only to metadata

A screen over this feed would run, commit and report nothing found -- which is indistinguishable from a quiet sky and is not a result. Read `results/tocsin_altfeeds/probe.json`; the request matrix there records responses and connection errors.
active.title: ASASSN cannot serve light curves
